verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management and team-communication SaaS, not a coding agent or development environment. Auto-detecting and installing toolchains and dependencies is outside its product category. Its AI-agent features (MCP support, Basecamp CLI and Skills) let agents work with Basecamp data; none of them provision build environments, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
